policy: No generated visual media used. Primary physical-installation photos ground the artistic direction; stock samples are secondary study. No reference media bundled.

references.title: SKALAR
references.creator: Christopher Bauder / WHITEvoid and Kangding Ray
references.provenance: Real kinetic light/sound installation; creator publication, with photography/video credits.
references.inspection: Creator text and actual published photo inspected; no full video/motion review.
references.observed: Blue luminous mirror rims and long coherent beams occupy a dark large interior. Shared colour and directional fans connect widely separated fixtures.
references.adaptation: Apply coherent broad colour gestures over the entire floor; keep black negative space. Do not reproduce mirror hardware or claim their private software technique.
references.use: Reference only; no images, video or third-party runtime assets bundled.

references.title: DEEP WEB
references.creator: Christopher Bauder / WHITEvoid and Robert Henke
references.provenance: Creator publication of a real light/sound installation using 175 motorized spheres and 12 laser systems.
references.inspection: Creator text and actual published photo inspected; motion timing not audited.
references.observed: A large yellow-green geometric fan spans the whole room; bright nodes trace a descending diagonal, while the surrounding suspended array remains much darker.
references.adaptation: Borrow spatial phase/contrast and mirrored movement across many cells. The proposed floor implementation does not need physical spheres or lasers.
references.use: Reference only; no source media/code imported.

references.title: CIRCULAR
references.creator: Christopher Bauder / WHITEvoid
references.provenance: Creator publication of three kinetic light-pixel rings.
references.inspection: Creator text and actual published photo inspected; no continuous video review.
references.observed: A few large red rings fill the composition. Only portions read as strongly emissive; their simple repeated silhouette carries the scene.
references.adaptation: Optional brief sparse arc/ring enclosure, with fade and restrained geometry. This is a new adaptation, not a recreation of the installation.
references.use: Reference only; no source media imported.

references.title: Stage Square Lights Background, 77850578
references.creator: Faraz Shakir; published by Vecteezy
references.provenance: Listed in the supplied EDM collection after selecting its Non-AI filter. Named contributor; site classification, not an independent authorship certification.
references.inspection: Decoded watermarked browser preview frames viewed. Ready state 4; replay checked at 0.253 s and 5.08 s. Continuous subjective motion review not performed.
references.observed: Repeated rows of soft white/cyan bulb-like points form bright bars and dim gaps across the frame. Bright and dark members coexist.
references.adaptation: Global row/block lighting and readable dim states; smooth musical offsets in our independent renderer. Not a single coloured patch.
references.use: Study only. Page labels Free License / attribution required. No stock clip downloaded into the pack or licensed for runtime use.

references.title: Neon disco grid fly-through, 56666488
references.creator: alasabyss; published by Vecteezy
references.provenance: Appeared under the supplied collection Non-AI filter, with a named contributor. Use as secondary study; classification is not independent certification.
references.inspection: Decoded watermarked browser preview sampled around 10.639 s; player reached the 20.02 s ending. No full motion/loop fidelity claim.
references.observed: Small points gather toward a vanishing region while larger soft elongated lights occupy the edges. Pink/blue lights sit in a dark surrounding space.
references.adaptation: Depth hierarchy and outward near-star swish under actual flight. Keep far points and black gaps; do not copy the dense tunnel or purple backdrop.
references.use: Study only; Pro Standard License / trial advertised. No purchase, source-media bundle or runtime clip reuse.

references.title: grandMA3 Phasers quick start
references.creator: MA Lighting
references.provenance: Official programming documentation; retrieved content identifies Version 1.9.
references.inspection: Text/instructions inspected; not a watched performance.
references.observed: The worked dimmer example distributes phases over fixtures and controls the transition curve between low/high steps. Phase 0 and 360 are the same point in a cycle.
references.adaptation: Smooth phase-offset brightness on one musical clock; use half-open N-group phases to avoid a duplicated endpoint.
references.use: Technical principle only; no console dependency or code copied.

references.title: MAtricks Groups and Wings
references.creator: MA Lighting
references.inspection: Main manual plus Groups and Wings examples read; no private show file inspected.
references.observed: Groups interleave selection members; wings select opposing directions. The grid system also exposes phase/fade/delay distribution.
references.adaptation: Stable world-cell group IDs, broad bank sizes, complementary brightness and mirror wings. This is an original web adaptation, not an exact MAtricks emulator.
references.use: Programming principles only; no copied diagrams or implementation.

references.title: WLED effects catalogue
references.creator: WLED Project contributors
references.inspection: Effect descriptions and parameters inspected. Linked GIF fetches failed; no animation/GIF fidelity claim.
references.observed: The catalogue documents palette colour waves, grouped chases, fading/twinkles and rotating colour bursts, with controllable scale, fade and speed.
references.adaptation: Select broad two-colour curtains and coherent phase shifts. Avoid per-frame random rainbow noise; original GLSL rather than transplanted controller code.
references.use: Concept reference; no WLED source code/media bundled.

references.title: ONYX club/EDM and DYLOS programming training
references.creator: Elation / Obsidian Control Systems; ZYPER and Matthias Hinrichs
references.provenance: Official training catalogue describes a club/EDM programming lesson with ZYPER and a DYLOS effects-composer webinar.
references.inspection: Catalogue descriptions and official lesson links verified. YouTube fetch failed/throttled; lesson footage/transcripts not inspected.
references.observed: Published training is directly about lighting programming/playback and a pixel composer.
references.adaptation: Receiving Codex can use these for further operator workflow study. This pack does not attribute undisclosed recipes to an unwatched lesson.
references.use: Further study links, not visual/technical proof of the proposed renderer.

references.title: Project Breakdown: Getting started with DMX LED-CHAINS
references.creator: Published contributor tutorial on Derivative
references.provenance: Developer-hosted tutorial about an actual 40-chain TouchDesigner/Art-Net LED stage project.
references.inspection: Article description and project download listing inspected; linked video/project internals not inspected.
references.observed: The author describes coordinated LED chain control and hardware/controller setup for an audio-reactive stage.
references.adaptation: Treat the many floor emitters as one mapped instrument. Do not add DMX, Art-Net or TouchDesigner to the existing website for this task.

references.title: Three.js PointsMaterial documentation
references.creator: Three.js contributors
references.inspection: Point size, perspective attenuation and hardware-cap notes read.
references.observed: Point size is pixel-based, can be hardware capped, and perspective attenuation changes its apparent depth size.
references.adaptation: Measure perceived star core size with DPR and the actual GL point-size range; use an economical near-billboard batch only if required.

excluded: Moment Factory Phish Sphere 2024 page explicitly describes AI-generated visuals; not used as a visual target.
Unfiltered Vecteezy AI entries and uninspected stock clips are not accepted design authority.
output_review_status: source/frame diagnosis only; new renderer, continuous listening/motion and physical-device checks pending
